decisions_for_user.question: On a harness that blocks MCP by policy, what permission posture should an unstated `claude` run get? Today it gets `manual` plus an approver flag naming an MCP tool that will never answer, and F299 measures the consequence: every mutating tool call is denied and the model tells the operator their machine is misconfigured.
decisions_for_user.why_it_is_yours: Every remedy moves containment, and `agent-capability-plane` says in as many words that the containment a run gets is the operator's to decide, separately from what the run is told. Resolving to `cli` on an inference hands every unstated `claude` run `acceptEdits`, which has no path check at all (runner_commands.py:66-67). Keeping `manual` and dropping the approver denies everything anyway, with nobody headless to ask. Leaving it as it is leaves F299. There is no non-widening, non-breaking option, so this is not the implementing window's to guess.
decisions_for_user.what_shipped_meanwhile: The description is now honest -- such a run is told the HTTP form and the plane works for it -- and the posture is untouched, so nothing widened. The one-line workaround that exists today is `hub_client: "cli"`, already documented in src/agentweave/config.py:714 as 'uncomment if MCP is blocked by company policy'. What it silently buys is `acceptEdits`, and nothing in the UI says so. ENLARGED 2026-09-09 by the c2-verify drives: F300 and F301 establish that there is no posture on this machine on which a claude run can use the HTTP form of the plane under its own power -- the default `workspace` posture's own approver denies the URL as a path outside the workspace (mcp_server.py:936), and the `cli` path's acceptEdits has no approver to overrule a harness that statically refuses an interpolated credential. So `hub_client: "cli"` restores writes, not access, and the choice in front of you now includes a third question the original did not: whether the workspace approver should recognise a URL at all.

limits: Stay on the cycle branch. No commits or rebases onto master, ever, by any window. No other step, and no other window, may merge, rebase, or commit onto master.

Nothing destructive: no deleting projects, databases, or kept reproductions.
Do not browse the open web. Research is AgentWeaveResearch's job, in a process that keeps the permission classifier.
